news: FEAT WizBee add stop button to stop the answer generation, which should be helpful if you ask something by mistake or if the answer is taking too long.
BUGFIX WizBee tokens were calculated wrong.
BUGFIX better and more accurate error message if the password reset key is not valid any more (thanks Elisabeth)
BUGFIX Editing charges was not anymore possible if the charge type was deleted.

FEATURE WizBee now supports tool calls and has access to app data. Its still early but new tools will be added slowly so nothing breaks. Also WizBee now uses Mistral to support european users better and to have a more transparent and open model.

FEATURE ToDo's can now be created for apiaries, which can be used for example to note down tasks that need to be done on the apiary level. In the ToDo table you can filter the apiary and on the apiary detail view the ToDo is incorporated in the task list.
FEATURE Cumulative Growing Degree Days (GTS) chart added to the apiary detail page (Grünlandtemperatursumme).
CHANGE Current temperature data from OpenWeather instead of Meteoblue, as Meteoblue changed their API and pricing model to be too expensive for us.
BUGFIX Added missing privacy policy and imprint links to footer on login.
BUGFIX Fixed state filter on tables, should now again filter for open and closed tasks correctly.

FEATURE Numeric values in tables now use tabular numbers for better readability.
